title: Lamb Tagine with Mediterranean Flair
description: A hearty and aromatic lamb tagine infused with the bold flavors of the Mediterranean. Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a truly authentic experience.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb pieces in batches until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add onion, garlic, and ginger.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 8 minutes.
Add cumin, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Return lamb to pot and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Transfer pot to the oven and cook, covered, at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours.
Shred lamb with two forks and serve hot.
